2.152.1
ChartLegend.Name
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartLegend.Name attribute specifies the name of a ChartLegend. This attribute MUST be
specified. The value of this attribute MUST be a case-sensitive CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15]
that is unique among the ChartLegend.Name values in the parent collection.
Following is the parent element of the ChartLegend.Name attribute.
Parent elements
ChartLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartLegend.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
